statement: The natural-language seam of the issue→PR crown: an issue written as ordinary prose ('Rename helper to compute in pkg/core.py') is parsed by strict anchored grammar, names bound through the verified symbol index (ambiguity/unknown names refuse with evidence), and the emitted choreograph ops feed python.software.issue_to_pr.orchestrate.v1 unchanged — producing a verified PR-ready diff with selected tests green. Refusal stories (unknown name with candidates, ambiguous name with homes, unsupported verbs) are as much the feature as the parsable ones.
